## Summary

Cut detection of higher-volume merchant outages from 20 minutes–2 hours to under 5, and held Merchant Portal at 99.9% availability with zero incidents during BFCM 2025. Ex-founder (Beginner Work Inc.). Targeting Engineering Manager / Senior EM roles in fintech (payments, platform/DevX, partner integrations).
